tha-ap513:1.1: Kaṇikāravaggo ekapaññāso. LII [508. Kureñjiyaphaladāyaka.] Migaluddo pure āsiṃ vivane vicaraṃ ahaṃ / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ. // //
tha-ap513:2.1: Kureñjiyaphalaṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭhass' adās ahaṃ / puññakkhettassa vīrassa pasanno sehi pāṇihi. // //
tha-ap513:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ phalaṃ adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap513:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Kureñjiyaphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
